Native bootstrap kits

Download ncc.

Get the ncc compiler for the nC programming language. Choose a V168 R4 archive for your operating system. Each contains the compiler, its matching runtime library and the license notices.

Windows x86-64

Windows

Native PE compiler and DLL provider. Keep both files in the same directory.

Download ZIP ↓
Linux x86-64

Linux and WSL

Native ELF compiler and shared library. Requires x86-64 Linux with glibc 2.34 or later.

Download TAR.GZ ↓

Before you start

Verify your archive using SHA-256 checksums. The installation guide walks through compiling your first program.

Download the matching compiler sources for the release. The source snapshot includes a file manifest for both platforms.
